prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one polished landscape art-direction board for a low-poly hand-painted BIRCH tree game asset. This is a painting concept for user approval, not a production atlas or a real engine render.
Reference image: use the supplied oak board ONLY to match its broad matte gouache brushwork, quiet warm ivory background, restrained layout, and level of stylization. Replace all oak forms with distinctive silver birch forms.
Composition: left half one elegant slender birch with airy irregular green crown, slender gently drooping twig tips and recognizable ivory-white trunk with charcoal interrupted horizontal marks and sparse darker knots. Right upper section a large isolated birch twig carrying small pointed triangular/rhombic serrated birch leaves, with generous readable gaps and several clusters. Right middle three individual leaves at a readable large scale showing restrained veins and broad painterly color patches. Right bottom a large flat bark painting swatch, ivory/cream/off-white with interrupted horizontal charcoal lenticel dashes, muted grey-beige papery patches and one subtle dark knot, alongside 6 small palette swatches. Bark must unmistakably read as birch, not brown oak plates, not zebra stripes.
Foliage: fresh subdued medium greens, moss and sage variations, sparse warm yellow-green highlights, matte hand-painted broad visible strokes, controlled contrast and simple readable silhouettes for future crossed foliage cards. Leaves pointed triangular with softly serrated edges, never lobed oak leaves, never needles. Bark white cream with restrained grey beige brushwork, not bright luminous pure white. Twig thin warm grey-brown transitioning naturally into white larger branches.
Lighting neutral and soft; avoid hard directional light painted into material swatches, no photorealism, no noisy microdetail, no glossy plastic, no moss, no flowers, no catkins, no autumn orange, no scenery, no polygon wireframes or technical text. Give tree a light airy silhouette rather than dense oak umbrella.
Only text, clean Spanish serif headings: "Abedul · propuesta de pintura" at top left and small subtitle "Concepto artístico · pendiente de aprobación". Optional small right labels "Follaje" and "Corteza". Make entire board beautiful and legible with generous spacing.
